blueTextParticulars.topic: Myanmar Telecom Authority & Optional China Yard Approvals
blueTextParticulars.note: All import/operating licenses shall be approved by Myanmar Telecommunication Authority. Optional Scope: VENDOR responsible for any necessary Approvals to import to China Fabrication Yard and export from China to Myanmar.

blueTextParticulars.topic: DMR + LNA & Ex d Surge Enclosure (TCAB-508-002)
blueTextParticulars.note: Changed from DTRS to DMR: Install Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) to extend DMR signal coverage on ZPQ main + Yagi Antenna + TCAB-508-002 (DMR Ex d Enclosure for RF Surge).

blueTextParticulars.topic: Myanmar Type Approval, Import & Operating License
blueTextParticulars.note: VENDOR responsible for application and requisition of any type approval (if required), import license and operating license of radio equipment (including antenna, peripherals and accessories).
Offshore commissioning and startup spare parts (1 set per platform) explicitly added in Rev.C1.

blueTextParticulars.topic: Optional Scope: China Yard Import & Export Approvals to Myanmar
blueTextParticulars.note: Optional Scope: a) VENDOR shall be responsible for any necessary Approvals that may require to import to China Fabrication Yard and export from China to Myanmar where the platforms are located.

blueTextParticulars.topic: Exhibit A Annex-8 Minimum List & Project SPIR Format
blueTextParticulars.note: VENDOR shall provide minimum spare parts / special tools per wellhead platform per Exhibit A Annex-8, and prepare Commissioning/Start-up + 2-Year Operating Spare Parts Lists using the Project's prescribed SPIR format.

blueTextParticulars.topic: BOD C2: DMR LNA/DAS & ZPQ–ZWP8 Bandwidth Upgrade
blueTextParticulars.note: Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) and Distribution Antenna System (DAS) shall be installed for DMR; after site survey, ZPQ–ZWP8 throughput was insufficient to extend links to ZWP20 and ZWP22.

blueTextParticulars.topic: SPE C2: Updated SCADA Radio Link Topology
blueTextParticulars.note: Updated SCADA wireless paths: ZPQ–ZWP23, ZPQ–ZWP8, ZWP8–ZWP20/22, and ZWP11–ZWP21.

blueTextParticulars.topic: DTS-0001: SCADA Brownfield Tags, 47W, RJ45/SFP & 5.5–5.8 GHz PTMP
blueTextParticulars.note: Updated brownfield TAGs (ZPQ/ZWP8/ZWP11), 47W power, 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 + SFP, >50kA surge, and 5500–5800 MHz PTMP operation on ZWP20–23.

blueTextParticulars.topic: DTS-0002: DMR LNA 380–520 MHz, 40 dB Gain & Yagi Antenna
blueTextParticulars.note: Extending DMR signal coverage to ZWP20/21/22: Frequency Band 380–520 MHz, Gain 40 dB, Outdoor Yagi Antenna & Ex Enclosure.

blueTextParticulars.topic: DTS-0003: Ex Telephone Cable Entry M20 × 4 Nos.
blueTextParticulars.note: Cable Entry Size M20, Number of Cable Entries 4 Nos. (blue-text Rev.C1 update).

blueTextParticulars.note: GRP Zone 1 IIA T3 IP66 Ex de IIC T4 Gb; II 2G Ex d IIB+H2 T5 Gb; M25 2 Nos. bottom with certified cable glands and certified plugs for spare entries.
